title: Higher Semiadditive Character Theory
summary: We introduce and develop the theory of semiadditive characters in the higher semiadditive setting, generalizing both the $T(n)$-local monoidal character and the $K(t)$-local transchromatic character. These are natural transformations compatible with restriction and transfer maps along $π$-finite spaces, with an $(n-t)$-fold $p$-typical free loop space correction built into the target. We show that every $\infty$-commutative monoid admits a universal $(n-t)$-fold character.
